```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}
#| eval: false
get_year_data <- function(year) {
  url <- str_c("https://www.boxofficemojo.com/daily/", year, "/?view=year")
  
  read_html(url) |> 
    html_node(css = "table") |> 
    html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE) |> 
    rename(
      date = Date,
      day_num = 'Day #',
      top10_gross = 'Top 10 Gross',
      percent_yd = '%± YD',
      percent_lw = '%± LW',
      releases = 'Releases',
      movie = '#1 Release',
      daily_gross = Gross
      ) |> 
    
    mutate(
      #remove holidays from date + signs
      date = str_extract(date, "^[A-Za-z]+ [A-Za-z]+ \\d{1,2}"),
      day_num = parse_number(day_num),
      top10_gross = parse_number(top10_gross),
      daily_gross = parse_number(daily_gross),
      percent_yd = parse_number(percent_yd),
      percent_lw = parse_number(percent_lw)
      ) |> 
    arrange(day_num)
}
#This function allows user to enter a four digit year, and will use that input to go to that years website
get_year_data(2026)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#gets data from a week and cleans it
scrape_week <- function(week, year = 2026){
  url <-str_c("https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekly/", year, "W", week, "/?ref_=bo_wl_nav")
  
  raw_table <- read_html(url) |> 
    html_node(css = "table") |> 
    html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  #renames columns
  clean_table <-raw_table |> 
    rename(
      rank = 1,
      last_week_rank = 2,
      movie = 3,
      weekly_gross = 4,
      pct_change_lw = 5,
      theaters = 6, 
      theater_change = 7, 
      avg_per_theater = 8,
      total_gross = 9,
      weeks_in_release = 10,
      distributor = 11
      ) |> 
    mutate(
      #creates a column showing which year and week the data is from
      week = str_c(year, "W", week),
      #replace "-" with NA value (cleaning the data)
      last_week_rank = parse_number(na_if(last_week_rank, "-")),
      pct_change_lw = parse_number(na_if(pct_change_lw, "-")),
      theater_change = parse_number(na_if(theater_change, "-")),
      rank = parse_number(rank),
weekly_gross = parse_number(weekly_gross),
total_gross = parse_number(total_gross),
theaters = parse_number(theaters),
avg_per_theater = parse_number(avg_per_theater),
weeks_in_release = parse_number(weeks_in_release)
    )
  clean_table
}

#use "" for weeks 01-09 example: scrape_week("01", 2026)
week09 <- scrape_week("09", 2026)
week10 <- scrape_week("10", 2026)
week11 <- scrape_week("11", 2026)

all_weeks <- bind_rows(week09, week10, week11)
```
